[[File:GemDiver_Station.jpg|thumb|right|200px|GemDiver Station was a mining station.]]
A '''mining station''' was a space station on which resources were mined from asteroids and other space materials; these materials were typically captured through the use of [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arms]] or [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] technology. Mining stations were distinct from standard mines (also known as shaft mines) in that shaft mines were fixed on the surface of celestial bodies. Mining stations were often controlled by private or state-owned mining guilds.<ref name="GEO">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
